description: This file defines the class OA_Algorithm_Dependency, which implements dependency tree algorithms for managing dependencies between items, including methods for calculating dependencies, scheduling, and handling orphaned items.

classes.name: OA_Algorithm_Dependency
classes.description: A class for managing dependency trees, calculating dependencies, and scheduling items based on dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dependency object with a source, selected items, and orphan handling flag.

methods.name: depends
methods.description: Returns a list of items that are dependencies for the given items.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of items to act upon, including dependencies, excluding already selected items.

methods.name: scheduleAll
methods.description: Returns a schedule including all unselected items.
